inference: The inspected author policies do not prescribe 22 human task reviews or dual-human labels per benchmark task. Author responsibility is distinct from the choice of annotation method.

sources.finding: General-purpose LLM assistance is permitted; human authors remain responsible and must meet the listed authorship criteria. LLMs cannot be authors.
The FAQ still states a human-source expectation for ideas, claims and results and calls for first-page disclosure; no withdrawal is asserted.
Claims need accurate, convincing evidence and clear communication; reducing unsupported claims is an available remedy.
